sloka: कर्तव्यमकृतं कार्यं सतां मन्युमुदीरयेत् ।सलिलादूर्ध्वमुत्तिष्ठ तिष्ठत्वेष कपिस्त्वयि ॥५-१-९८॥
transliteration: kartavyamakṛtaṁ kāryaṁ satāṁ manyumudīrayet ।salilādūrdhvamuttiṣṭha tiṣṭhatveṣa kapistvayi ॥5-1-98॥

translations.english: "Rise up from the waters. Let him rest on you since this noble monkey is our guest and worthy of worship.
